meta.name: credential-activation
meta.description: Configure environment credentials for skills that require API keys or secrets. Use when a skill reports missing credentials, or when setting up a new space that will use authenticated services (Mailgun, OpenAI, external APIs).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置密钥，让技能立即就绪
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到技能提示缺少密钥而无法运行
copy.tagline_en: Configure credentials to make skills ready instantly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often see missing credential errors when running skills

howto.what: 当技能报告缺少 API 密钥时，Claude 会查看该技能需要哪些凭据，检查环境变量是否已配置，提供在 TeamDay 的 Secrets 中添加密钥的分步指引，并验证凭据能否正常使用。
howto.when: 当技能提示缺少所需凭据（如 API 密钥），或在新空间配置使用认证服务（如 Mailgun、OpenAI 等）时触发。

say.text: 检查一下邮件通知技能的凭据是否配置好了。
say.note: 它会检查环境变量并报告状态。

say.text: 帮我设置 Mailgun 的 API 密钥和发信域名。
say.note: 它会给出在 Secrets 中添加这些值的步骤。

say.text: 验证一下 OpenAI 的 API 密钥是否有效。
say.note: 它会调用验证命令测试。

howto.what_en: When a skill reports missing credentials, Claude inspects which variables are needed, checks if they are set in the environment, provides step-by-step instructions to add secrets in TeamDay's Secrets tab, and verifies that the credentials work.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a skill indicates missing credentials, or when setting up a new space that will use authenticated services such as Mailgun, OpenAI, etc.

say_en.text: Check if the mail notification skill's credentials are configured.
say_en.note: It checks environment variables like MAILGUN_API_KEY.

say_en.text: Help me set up Mailgun API key and sending domain.
say_en.note: It guides adding these secrets in TeamDay.

say_en.text: Verify if the OpenAI API key works.
